Bulk Barcode Generator

Need barcodes for a whole product list or a set of asset tags? Paste your values, one per line, pick a barcode type and the tool draws all of them. Download everything as a single ZIP of PNG images, with each file named after its value.

How to use Bulk Barcode Generator

  1. Copy a column from your spreadsheet and paste it into the box, one value per line.
  2. Choose the barcode type that matches your values.
  3. Check the preview. Any value that doesn't fit the type is listed so you can fix it.
  4. Click download to get all barcodes as a ZIP.

Frequently asked questions

How many barcodes can I make at once?

Up to 300 per batch. Duplicate lines are removed automatically.

Can I paste from Excel or Google Sheets?

Yes. Copy one column of cells and paste it. Each cell becomes one line, which becomes one barcode.

What happens to values that are invalid?

They are skipped and listed above the preview with the reason, so you can correct them and try again.

Is anything uploaded?

No. All barcodes are made and zipped in your browser.
